title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E13 — Chester Himes/The Dells
Author Chester Himes is welcomed back from self-exile in Europe on this show devoted primarily to his writings. Actor Al Freeman Jr., who reads from Himes' autobiography, and The Dells, who sing several of their hits, join the welcome.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E14 — Belafonte/Nelson/Poitier
Sidney Poitier and Harry Belafonte discuss their new film, Buck and the Preacher, as well as other topics, interrupted by interludes of song by Novella Nelson.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E9 — Thanksgiving Story
Webster, George, and Katherine are all trying to have a peaceful Thanksgiving. But things don't turn out the way they plan when George's aggressive father and Katherine's snobby mother arrive for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E12 — Too Much Class
After Webster transfers to an advanced learning class, his grades start to slip.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E15 — Runaway
After she ran away seven years ago, Bill and Cassie's daughter returns to her parents.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E20 — What is Art?
Webster makes a mistake by accidentally recycling Uncle Phil's tin can sculpture.

title: Webster
description:
S2 E21 — Best of Friends
Webster isn't speaking to his best friend David, and George hopes if he apologizes to his friend Bill (with whom he also had a disagreement during a board game), that Webster will make up with his friend too.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E5 — Out Alone
While taking a bus to the movies, Tia and Tamera fight over the disadvantages of being a twin, but when they get lost, they must team up to find their way home.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E6 — The Pimple
When a pimple pops up just before Tia's big date, Tamera agrees to step in for her -- and finds herself falling for Tia's guy.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E7 — Car Trouble
Tamera scratches the fender of her father's prized car, then tries to hide the truth with the help of Tia and Roger.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E8 — The Birthday
The twins' first birthday together leaves Tamera's best friend feeling left out, and Ray locked in an argument with Lisa over his parenting methods.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E9 — Love Strikes
Fearing they'll be separated forever if Ray and Lisa marry other people, Tia and Tamera plot to derail Ray's new romance.

title: Moesha
description:

Mo decides to publish her own Bridgewood newspaper when editor Mary Ellen refuses to add her to the staff of the existing paper.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E17 — She’s Back
A famous female broadcast journalist who used to be friends with Frank speaks at Bridgewood, so Mo invites her to their house for dinner.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E18 — Model Employee
Rather than asking Frank every time she wants something, Mo decides to get a part-time job at the Class Act where Hakeem works.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E19 — Mo’s Money, Mo’s Money, Mo’s Money
Moesha wants to get cable and her own phone now that she has a job and is making money.

title: Moesha
description:

Mo, Kim, Hakeem, Niecy, Morgan, Marco, and Chris head off on a road trip to San Diego.

S3 E23 — The Big Deal
Mary has a terrible time trying to be polite to Fox, who is rude and obnoxious yet potentially important to Lester's financial future.

S3 E24 — The Butler Did It
When Mary and Rose win the services of a butler in the church raffle, they look forward to the pampered life until they meet the pain-in-the-neck hired help.

S2 E1 — The Handwriting On The Wall
Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.
